naive_cross_sectional.label: Naive: adopters vs never-adopters
naive_cross_sectional.note: No controls. Measures who joined, not what joining did.

twfe.label: Two-way fixed effects
twfe.note: Baseline is the full pre-period average.

cs_att.label: Callaway-Sant'Anna (primary estimator)
cs_att.note: Baseline is the week before adoption.

mde_empirical.label: Minimum detectable effect
mde_empirical.note: 2.8 x the SD of 500 in-time placebo estimates. Supersedes the §10 formula range of 0.23-1.19%.

placebo_intime.label: In-time placebo on never-adopters
placebo_intime.note: 500 fake adoption assignments. Design does not manufacture effects.

placebo_date.label: Placebo adoption date
placebo_date.note: FAILS. Fake adoption 26 weeks early yields a large negative effect.

placebo_dose.label: Placebo adoption date, by shift length
placebo_dose.note: Fake adoption N weeks before the real one, panel truncated at real adoption. A null result is expected at every shift.

honest_did.label: Honest DiD breakdown value
honest_did.note: Smallest parallel-trends violation at which the CI includes zero. Applied work treats values below 1 as fragile.

leave_one_out.label: Leave-one-cohort-out
leave_one_out.note: Dropping the largest cohort takes the estimate below the MDE.

distrust_conditions.text: Pre-trend coefficients trending in the direction of the estimate
distrust_conditions.evidence: Treated stores converge downward toward controls pre-adoption.

distrust_conditions.text: Placebo treatment date producing an effect of similar magnitude
Estimate flipping sign across reasonable specifications
distrust_conditions.evidence: No sign flip, but 62 of 128 specifications fall below the MDE.

distrust_conditions.text: Goodman-Bacon showing nearly all weight on already-treated comparisons

conclusion: Three §12 distrust conditions have fired. The estimate is not reported as a causal effect of Promo2: this data cannot separate the program's effect from mean reversion among stores that adopted during a decline.
